checks.name: Outer admission, CRC, safe paths and cryptographic coverage
checks.evidence: 25 ZIP members, CRC PASS; 23/23 payloads match exact manifest bytes/SHA-256 and 23/23 checksum entries; no traversal, duplicates, non-regular members.

checks.name: Deterministic non-generative source
checks.evidence: AST/source inspection: standard library + Matplotlib only, three savefig operations, SVG/PDF/PNG; no image-generation AI, external service, network/import invocation or model execution evidenced.

checks.name: Recorded double-render identity and delivered binding
checks.evidence: Local QA records equal A/B SHA-256 and byte counts for SVG/PDF/PNG; independent hash and size readback of each delivered binary matches both recorded A and B identities. See evidentiary limitation below.

checks.name: 180 x 165 mm geometry / <=170 mm height
checks.evidence: SVG dimensions 510.23622 x 467.716535 pt = 180.0000 x 165.0000 mm; PDF page same physical size.

checks.name: Final-size 5–7 pt labels
checks.evidence: Rendered SVG/PDF visible text sizes 5.0, 5.05, 5.1, 5.15, 5.2, 5.25, 5.5, 6.3, 6.6 and 6.8 pt; no visible text below 5 or above 7 pt.

checks.name: Editable SVG and safe font stack
checks.evidence: 89 SVG <text> elements; zero <image>; font family Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; no text-to-path or linked raster.

checks.name: Single-page vector PDF, legible text
checks.evidence: 1 PDF page; 83 vector drawing objects; zero embedded raster images; 89 selectable Helvetica/Helvetica-Bold spans; extractable material text.

checks.name: Approximate 300 dpi PNG
checks.evidence: 2125 x 1948 pixels, (299.9994,299.9994) dpi metadata, RGBA with fully opaque alpha.

checks.name: F01 module connection topology
checks.evidence: Source and visual inspection: single horizontal module-region connection at entry coordinate of MODULE OUTPUT only; no mid-chain bypass.

checks.name: Complete interface chain
checks.evidence: Six labeled nodes in order; five vertical connecting arrows: MODULE OUTPUT -> VERSIONED DATA CONTRACT -> CATALOG RECORD -> PROVENANCE / EVIDENCE BINDING -> INTEGRATION ADAPTER -> CONSUMER MODULE.

checks.name: F02 separation from runtime boundary
checks.evidence: Independent MM assurance != formal external IV&V inside the lower-right assurance area, visually separated by whitespace from the bottom runtime band.

checks.name: Certification is not authorization
checks.evidence: Explicit FROZEN / CERTIFIED != RUNTIME AUTHORIZED; five runtime class labels shown without authorized status.

checks.name: F03 publication-size layout and clipping
checks.evidence: Direct final-size PNG/color and grayscale inspected; no material overlap/clipping discernible. PDF text spans do not extend beyond page boundaries.

checks.name: Superior authorities
checks.evidence: Three correctly named superior authorities: Architecture v1.0.2, Manual v1.0.1 RC3, Project Evidence Base v1.0.0.

checks.name: Non-normative Methodology
checks.evidence: Controlled Methodology v1.0.1 explicitly marked human-readable and non-normative; no supersession claim.

checks.name: Four-plane certified execution-control core
checks.evidence: CONTROL, EXECUTION, AUTHORITY and EVIDENCE/PROVENANCE planes retained with distinct headings.

checks.name: Cross-cutting Data/Catalog layer
checks.evidence: DATA / CATALOG GOVERNANCE is an independently dashed cross-cutting layer, not a fifth certified plane.

checks.name: Six bounded modules
checks.evidence: MM-ENVIRONMENT; MM-PLANT; MM-ANIMAL; MM-ECONOMIC; MM-INTEGRATION-CORE; MM-DATA-CATALOG, plus boundary rule.

checks.name: Nine stages / eight Gates
checks.evidence: Nine numbered scientific development stages, 1 through 9; eight labeled, directed Gate transitions in serpentine order.

checks.name: Verification distinct from validation
checks.evidence: Separate definitions and boxes: building system correctly vs correct system for intended scientific use.

checks.name: Historical WSL2 adapter inset
checks.evidence: Dotted local adapter inset explicitly says historical view; Windows -> WSL2 -> /opt/mm and adapter != architecture.

checks.name: Parent SVG geometry identical
checks.evidence: v1.0.1 and v1.0.2 have 83/83 exactly identical SVG path d values; all other non-colour structural attributes and clip geometry identical after normalizing clip IDs.

checks.name: Parent scientific text invariant
checks.evidence: 89/89 SVG text elements preserve position/style; only two figure-version identifiers changed from v1.0.1 to v1.0.2. PDF extracted lines independently agree.

checks.name: Canvas and visible typography invariant
checks.evidence: Parent and candidate SVG width/height/viewBox identical; 89 text styles, per-text transforms and visible font-size sets identical.

checks.name: Colour redundant to semantics
checks.evidence: Position, text, sectional borders, dashed/solid styling and arrow topology retained exactly; grayscale conveys all labeled relations.

checks.name: No red-green semantic contrast
checks.evidence: Accessible palette uses pastel blue, teal, ochre, lavender and neutrals without a red-versus-green status key or semantic opposition.

checks.name: No rainbow/continuous scale
checks.evidence: Discrete fills for fixed named sections; no colour bar, heatmap, rainbow gradient or continuum in SVG/PNG.

checks.name: Grayscale interpretability
checks.evidence: Provided grayscale PNG is exactly byte-pixel-equivalent to independently converting delivered RGB image with PIL L-to-RGB; section labels, connectors and distinctions are legible.

checks.name: Contrast independently recalculated
checks.evidence: WCAG relative luminance recomputed for 12 supplied light fills against black: minimum 16.591864:1 for #E8E2F2, exceeding 4.5:1; matches local QA.

checks.name: Colour not status/authority signifier
checks.evidence: No fill encodes PASS, scientific result, certification or run permission alone; runtime state explicitly textual.

checks.name: RGB and Nature-facing guidance alignment
checks.evidence: Opaque RGB/RGBA PNG and RGB SVG palette; Nature Computational Science official formatting specifies <=180 mm and 5–7 pt sans-serif; Nature guidance supports RGB, distinct accessible colours, no red-green contrast/rainbow.

checks.name: Restrained professional hierarchy
checks.evidence: Direct colour-versus-parent and grayscale visual review: muted fills group categories without gradients, decorative effects or additional semantic categories.

checks.name: Concise matched legend
checks.evidence: 621-byte separate legend begins with a brief title, names principal regions, describes non-normative derivative, avoids process-level methodology.

checks.name: Correct and complete alt text
checks.evidence: 1,553-byte alt text tracks three authorities, four planes, six modules, six contract nodes, nine stages, V&V/IV&V separation, runtime band and redundant colour.

checks.name: No new scientific or normative claim
checks.evidence: Only two figure-version text tokens and colour attrs differ from parent; 83 vector paths, 89 text positions/styles and all material scientific labels preserved.

checks.name: No downstream execution/publication authority
checks.evidence: Control decision and launch prohibit MkDocs insertion, GitHub Pages, scientific runtime and publication submission; this readback only establishes publication-asset eligibility.
